references.text: Jesus predicts his death and resurrection, which is directly related to his statement in Matthew 17:23 about being killed and raised on the third day.
Jesus teaches the disciples about his death and resurrection, parallel to the event in Matthew 17:23.
Jesus explains that he must suffer, be killed, and rise again on the third day, reflecting his words in Matthew 17:23.
Jesus speaks of his death and resurrection, which corresponds with his prediction in Matthew 17:23.
The prophecy that Israel will be revived after two days and live before God's face on the third day can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' resurrection on the third day mentioned in Matthew 17:23.
